description: This file contains utility classes and functions for routing search API calls within the LiteLLM framework, including search tool management, load balancing, and fallback mechanisms.

classes.name: SearchAPIRouter
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods for search API routing, including search tool updates, matching, and fallback search execution.

methods.name: update_router_search_tools
methods.description: Updates the router with search tools fetched from the database, converting them into the expected format.

methods.name: get_matching_search_tools
methods.description: Retrieves all search tools matching a given name from the router's search tools list.

methods.name: async_search_with_fallbacks
methods.description: Performs a search API call with load balancing and fallback support, using the router's infrastructure.

methods.name: async_search_with_fallbacks_helper
methods.description: Helper function that selects a search tool and executes the original search function, used during retries.
